title: Polish Mushroom Dumplings
description: A hearty Polish dish made with savory mushroom filling and served with a side of spicy sauce. Perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook dumplings according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add sliced mushrooms and cook until browned.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened. Add caraway seed and cook for 1 minute.
Combine cooked mushroom mixture with flour, egg, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Wrap dumpling dough around mushroom filling and seal edges.
Cook dumplings in boiling water for 5-7 minutes or until cooked through.
Serve with spicy sauce and enjoy!
